import os, json, datetime, re
base='/Users/mac/.cursor/projects/Users-mac-Desktop-CHcode/agent-transcripts'
day=datetime.date(2026,11,17)
rows=[]
for root,dirs,files in os.walk(base):
  for fn in files:
    if not fn.endswith('.jsonl'): continue
    p=os.path.join(root,fn)
    mt=datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(os.path.getmtime(p)).date()
    # include files touched today OR parent folder created today
    parent_mt=datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(os.path.getmtime(os.path.dirname(p))).date()
    if mt!=day and parent_mt!=day: continue
    # skip if folder name from before? use mtime of jsonl
    if mt!=day: continue
    uid=os.path.basename(os.path.dirname(p))
    first_user=''; last_assistant=''; users=[]
    try:
      with open(p,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace') as f:
        for line in f:
          try: o=json.loads(line)
          except: continue
          role=o.get('role') or o.get('type') or ''
          # cursor transcript format varies
          msg=o.get('message') or o
          if isinstance(msg,dict):
            role=msg.get('role') or role
            content=msg.get('content')
          else:
            content=o.get('content') or o.get('text')
          text=''
          if isinstance(content,str): text=content
          elif isinstance(content,list):
            parts=[]
            for c in content:
              if isinstance(c,str): parts.append(c)
              elif isinstance(c,dict):
                parts.append(str(c.get('text') or c.get('content') or ''))
            text='\n'.join(parts)
          text=text.strip()
          if not text: continue
          if role in ('user','human') or o.get('type')=='user':
            users.append(text[:200].replace('\n',' '))
          elif role in ('assistant','ai') or o.get('type')=='assistant':
            last_assistant=text[:220].replace('\n',' ')
    except Exception as e:
      continue
    if not users: continue
    rows.append((os.path.getmtime(p), uid, users[0], users[-1] if len(users)>1 else '', last_assistant, len(users)))

rows.sort(reverse=True)
print('sessions', len(rows))
for m,uid,u0,ul,a,nu in rows[:20]:
  print('\n==', datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(m).strftime('%H:%M'), uid[:8], 'users', nu)
  print('U0:', u0[:220])
  if ul and ul!=u0: print('UL:', ul[:220])
  print('A :', a[:220])
PY
